body:
Heey sadly I have to report somebody.
Reported Player(s): gibbodaman (http://avicus.net/gibbodaman)
Rules Broken: starting flamewars (most of his tries failed) and being racist.
Evidence: Being racist: http://prntscr.com/4axrsi (maybe just remove the post) This is the topic, why I report him: http://avicus.net/forums/4fd9beb60 and here is another picture of starting a flamewar:http://prntscr.com/4axtgc.

I told him before he don't have to be so rude, but nothing. I don't see an other way to stop it. Awesome_apricot is doing her job and told him to stop, but nothing.. He just do it...
I ask myself why?... (not why staff don't do something. Why, because why are you so ignorant to miss it that you did something wrong. Why, he doesn't stop?)
Please do something against this. I'm worried about our great Community <3
